summary.text: Mike Harrington (listed by Ballotpedia as Michael Harrington) is a Republican state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 18 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a consultant and former member of the New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission.

paragraphs.text: Harrington earned a B.S. in nuclear engineering from the University of Massachusetts at Lowell.

His career experience includes working as a consultant with Harrington Consultants, a senior regional policy advisor with the New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission and a procurement engineering supervisor with the Seabrook Nuclear Power Plant.

Harrington served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2000 to 2004, was a member of the Public Utilities Commission from November 2004 to December 2005, and was appointed to the commission again in March 2012.
He returned to the House in 2016 and was reelected in Strafford 3 in 2018 and 2020 and in Strafford 18 in 2022 and 2024.
He served on the Science, Technology and Energy Committee in the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and faces Thom Flynn (D) in the general election.
